text:
sam: aps1-rack12-slot07 just had a sudden PCIe/GPU fault — kernel OOPS + node crash. ECC correctable -> uncorrectable spike, some pods evicted. Observed ~9% GPU capacity drop in aps1. Starting drain now, any objections?

jia: Copy. Any immediate customer impact? latency/queueing? Which pools were on that host?

sam: Dedicated pool 'redwood-ded-aps1' had 2 pods there, they're evacuating. p50 latency for short seq gen up ~30ms, overall throughput steady. I'll run a graceful drain and remove from LB.

deploy-bot: Action: routing removed for node aps1-rack12-slot07 (removed from LB pools).

mike: Run graceful drain then stop service:```kubectl drain node/aps1-rack12-07 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
systemctl stop redwood-inference``` Also cordon afterwards.

sam: Running that now. cordon + drain in progress. Will post logs if anything weird.

leah: If this is a hardware failure we should open HW ticket and schedule board swap. Also suggest shifting canaries out of aps1 -> eu-west-2 for next 2h to avoid regressions. Ops, confirm spare capacity in eu-west-2.

ops-eng: eu-west-2 has ~25% spare GPU capacity for bursts, can take canaries and low-priority traffic. Not enough to absorb large reserved dedicated shifts. Recommend non-dedicated traffic first and keep routing for committed customers on standby.

jia: Opened HW ticket HW-4321 and kicked vendor RMA. ETA for board swap ~36h. Also enabling fallback to quantized model variant to lower per-token load.

sam: Enabled fallback policy for gpt-open-20b -> gpt-open-20b-q4 and started prefix/KV cache warmup on target nodes.

mike: @sam @jia tagging me on HW-4321. I'll coordinate physical swap. Plan to bring host back to maintenance rack, swap board, soak test, then rejoin.

oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-03-18-aps1-rack12-gpu-failure created and assigned to oncall_jia.

sam: Plan recap: 1) cordon & drain node, 2) removed from routing, 3) shift canaries -> eu-west-2, 4) enable quantized fallback, 5) HW ticket & RMA (HW-4321), 6) board swap + soak before rejoin. Expect node offline ~36-48h. Any gaps?

leah: No gaps. Quick finance FYI: cross-region routing and extra warmup will add roughly ~$120/day in egress & warmup costs while traffic is shifted. Please flag finance for chargeback.

mike: Will draft a short postmortem after hardware swap and soak tests. ETA to rejoin ~40h depending on vendor.

jia: Thanks team. I'll keep the incident open and update status in #incidents and here as things change. Marking this thread for follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
